summary: Perf-slot receipts retain the originating commit and tree when CI runs a synthetic sparse checkout

schema.detail: Diagnostic receipts gain origin_head, origin_tree and sparse_head fields; source_head remains the current-checkout alias.

rules.detail: ci-sparse-tree writes versioned origin metadata under its private git directory, outside tracked inputs. Perf-slot receipts read that metadata, reject a stale synthetic HEAD or malformed origin identity, and retain both origin and sparse identities after checkout cleanup. Ordinary checkouts use their own commit and tree as the origin.

compatibility.detail: Receipt validation checks origin identity and the sparse/source alias when origin_head is present. Older receipts without origin fields remain supported. Sparse inputs, the synthetic commit tree and fixture resource limits are unchanged.

recovery.detail: Revert to retain only the synthetic checkout identity in diagnostic receipts.
